definitions.explanation: the act of cutting something out, or the resulting cut-out piece; commonly refers to coupons, sections of forms, or digital editing functions

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{取|と}り{線|せん}に{沿|そ}って{切|き}ってください。
examples.english: Please cut along the cutting line.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}の{記事|きじ}を{切|き}り{取|と}りした。
テキストの{切|き}り{取|と}りと{貼|は}り{付|つ}けは、{基本的|きほんてき}な{操作|そうさ}です。
examples.english: Cut and paste of text is a basic operation.

notes:
COMMON USES:

PHYSICAL:
- {切|き}り{取|と}り{線|せん} - perforated/cutting line (on forms, coupons)
- {新聞|しんぶん}{切|き}り{取|と}り - newspaper clipping
- クーポンの{切|き}り{取|と}り - coupon cutting

DIGITAL/COMPUTING:
- {切|き}り{取|と}りと{貼|は}り{付|つ}け - cut and paste
- {画像|がぞう}の{切|き}り{取|と}り - image cropping
- {選択|せんたく}{範囲|はんい}を{切|き}り{取|と}る - to cut the selected area

RELATED TERMS:
- コピー - copy
- {貼|は}り{付|つ}け - paste
- トリミング - trimming/cropping (photos)

VERB FORM:
{切|き}り{取|と}る (to cut out) → {切|き}り{取|と}り (noun form)
